headline: 3 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi road crash during Umrah trip
summary: Three members of a family from Faridpur died in a tragic accident in Makkah. The head of the family remains seriously injured.
details: Three Bangladeshi nationals from a single family were killed in a road accident in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, while performing Umrah.
The tragic incident occurred on Thursday, July 23, on a road in Makkah.
The head of the family was also seriously injured in the crash and is currently receiving treatment at a local hospital.
caption:
A family's pilgrimage to Makkah ends in tragedy as three members are killed in a road crash.

Three Bangladeshi nationals from a single family were killed in a road accident in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, while performing Umrah.

The tragic incident occurred on Thursday, July 23, on a road in Makkah.

The head of the family was also seriously injured in the crash and is currently receiving treatment at a local hospital.

headline_marked: US probes [[Russian role in Iranian drone attacks]] on CIA sites
headline: US probes Russian role in Iranian drone attacks on CIA sites
summary: Intelligence officials are investigating whether Moscow provided targeting data or advanced technology for strikes on CIA facilities in Riyadh and eastern Iraq.
details: The US is conducting an intelligence probe to determine if Russia assisted Iran in drone attacks targeting CIA facilities in the Gulf. The investigation focuses on whether Moscow provided critical targeting data or advanced drone technology.

At least two CIA sites were hit in March, including the agency's station within the US embassy in Riyadh and another facility in eastern Iraq. Some sources suggest more sites may have been struck, though specific numbers remain closely guarded.

An internal Western intelligence memo concluded that Russia likely played a role in the targeting. Reports indicate the Saudi attack involved Russian-enhanced Shahed drones, with one piercing the embassy's exterior and another detonating inside.

Analysts believe Moscow helped Iran upgrade Shahed drones with satellite navigation systems, such as Russia's Kometa-M. This technology makes drones more accurate and significantly harder to jam than original Iranian versions.

While some analysts suggest the embassy strike could have been accidental, others argue few nations possess both the capability and motive to weaponize such intelligence. Former CIA chief Daniel Hoffman noted that Moscow and Tehran share a goal of reducing US influence.
